## Request type

- [ ] Starter / Creator / Pro package access
- [ ] Custom poetry content pack
- [ ] Workflow or WebUI customization
- [ ] Licensing question
- [ ] Other commercial request

## Brief request

Please describe the intended use, target audience, approximate scope, and desired delivery format. Do not include passwords, API keys, customer data, private URLs, or other sensitive information.

## Preferred public reply

Please reply with a safe public summary. Private contact and payment details should be exchanged only through an authorized private channel after the request is accepted.
